explosive_kg.note: a game reference: War Thunder's su_r_73 (OKFOL); no manufacturer or encyclopedia gives the charge

gurney_kms.note: OKFOL (phlegmatized HMX, Russian) is not in Cooper's table: as PBX 9404 (2.90, 94 % HMX) - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00295, its base 0.00107, its fins' friction 0.00226 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.0598 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.981 for its fineness 17.7 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
